public_anchor.text: Credit Committee approval/formal review required; no credit limit modification.
Allocation pairing is not retained on Xero rows; handler only changes CN remaining_credit and invoice amount_due, so separate transitions cannot prove which CN paid which invoice.
Internal credit policy says notify draft note as pending, while system instruction requires silent exclusion; no excluded-item notification is required by system scope.
